replaceNanMatlabCodeMatchesTheMex: na:replace_nan_with_value.m is MATLAB's code for systems without the mex (macOS); the port has one implementation on every system, which its oracle cases compare with the mex

fate: na:MATLAB unloads mex files at exit, before the threads of their OpenMP runtime have ended (the macOS crash); CPython never unloads extension modules
